stories.title: Taiwan man wins lawsuit but gets jailed for using robot vacuum to record wife’s affair
stories.summary: A man in Taiwan who used a robot vacuum cleaner to gather evidence of his wife’s affair won a civil lawsuit but was subsequently sentenced to prison for invading her privacy. A recently released court ruling, reported by local media, disclosed that the man, whose identity remains confidential, got married in 2021.
